simple.meaning: מוֹשְׁכָה (môwshᵉkâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “something drawing , i.e. (figuratively) a cord.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: This word has limited occurrence data, so BibleIQ begins with the Hebrew word, its basic meaning, and the verse where it appears.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מוֹשְׁכָה (H4189) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in מוֹשְׁכָה (H4189) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: מוֹשְׁכָה (môwshᵉkâh) / H4189 is traced through Job 38:31 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H4189. moshekah or mosheketh [ משֶׁ֫כֶת ] noun feminine cord ; — only plural construct כְּסִיל משְׁכוֺת Job 38:31 the cords of Orion , i.e. probably those by which (according to some legend) he is dragged along in the sky (compare Di). מִשְׁכָּב see שׁכב . מִשְׁכָּן see שׁכן .
